Title: Prepare
Description:
Put on gloves. Fill a jug with 500 ml hot water and 1 cleaning tablet.
Place the blind basket in the group handle.

Title: Backflush with cleaner
Description: Lock in the group handle and run the pump.

Title: Rest
Description: Stop the pump and let the cleaner sit in the group head.

Title: Repeat backflush
Description: Run and stop the pump 5 more times.

Title: Soak parts
Description: Soak group handles and baskets in the cleaning jug.

Title: Purge steam wand
Description: Wipe the wand with a damp cloth, then open the steam valve.

Title: Rinse
Description: Rinse all parts under running water and refit them.

Title: Flush with water
Description: Backflush with clean water (blind basket, no tablet) to remove any cleaner.

Title: Test shot
Description: Pull one shot and discard it. Check taste before serving.
